content: @fastify/cookie (v11.1.1 per npm registry, matches CLAUDE.md's pinned version) is the Fastify v5-compatible cookie plugin. Provides reply.setCookie(name,value,options) / reply.cookie() alias, request.cookies, and signed-cookie support via a 'secret' option passed at registration (or per-call sign/unsign functions) so a client cannot forge a cookie's value. hook option (default 'onRequest') controls when cookies are parsed onto the request.
